record.question: First class brick when immersed in water for one hour should not absorb water more than
record.explanation: As per IS 1077, first class bricks should not absorb more than 1/5 (20%) of their weight when immersed in water for one hour. This indicates low porosity and high durability.

record.question: For all wall thickness, the bond considered to be the strongest is
record.explanation: English bond (alternating courses of headers and stretchers) is considered the strongest masonry bond for all wall thicknesses as it provides maximum interlocking and load distribution.

record.question: A covering of stone, concrete, brick of terracotta placed on the exposed top of a wall to prevent seepage of water is
record.explanation: Coping is a protective covering placed on the exposed top of a wall, parapet, or fence to shed water and prevent water seepage and damage to the wall below.

record.question: A retaining wall built parallel to the centre line of road is called
record.explanation: A revetment wall is built parallel to a road, river, or other linear feature to provide support and prevent erosion or slope failure along that alignment.
